hero.subtitle: Not improving farming. Reinventing it
hero.description: Agriculture + Aquaculture + BioTech + NanoTech + AI + Carbon + IoT

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To empower rural communities with the tools, technologies, and ecosystems needed to produce smarter, cleaner, and higher-value crops, while creating a carbon-positive and economically resilient India.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: AGLOUD's mission is to turn every acre into an innovation-driven ecosystem by integrating precision agriculture, smart aquaculture, biotech innovations, nanotechnology, artificial intelligence, and carbon tracking to build sustainable, measurable green impact.
points: Precision Agriculture using IoT and sensors
Smart Aquaculture for water-efficient protein production
Biotech innovations for plant resilience and soil health
Nanotechnology for advanced fertilizers and preservation
Artificial Intelligence for predictive analytics and automation
Carbon tracking to build sustainable, measurable green impact

corePillars.title: Smart Agriculture
corePillars.description: Sensor-driven soil and crop management with real-time AI insights. Helps farmers make data-backed irrigation, fertilizer, and yield decisions.

corePillars.title: Aquaculture & Hydroponics
corePillars.description: Modern water farming for shrimp, fish, and plant proteins using minimal water footprint and precision monitoring systems.

corePillars.title: Biotech & Nanotech
corePillars.description: Leveraging biotechnology for disease-resistant crops and nanotech for controlled nutrient release — combining science with soil.

corePillars.title: AI, IoT & Data Analytics
corePillars.description: Connecting farms, labs, and markets through intelligent networks for remote monitoring, automation, and market forecasting.

corePillars.title: Carbon & Sustainability
corePillars.description: Tracking, measuring, and monetizing carbon reduction at every level — empowering rural producers to earn from sustainable practices.

programs.title: Smart Village Project
programs.description: Creating pilot hubs integrating tech, training, and sustainability for holistic rural transformation.

programs.title: GreenHouse 24x7
programs.description: Climate-controlled high-yield farming using nanotech for year-round optimal production.

programs.title: BlueProtein
programs.description: AI-based aquaculture farms for fish and prawns with precision monitoring and sustainable practices.

programs.title: Carbon+
programs.description: A digital carbon tracking and monetization platform empowering farmers to earn from green practices.

techStack: IoT Sensors – Soil, water, and weather tracking
AI Models – Predictive crop yield & disease alerts

contact.message: Innovation should begin where the soil breathes — in the villages. AGLOUD is not just a company; it's a movement towards a new kind of rural intelligence — one that connects technology, nature, and people.
